cases.raw_entry_text: Apurei [HLL] n 1a April. < Eng. cp Kubvumbi KMZ.
ara [HL] n 1a & 9 The letter r.
-badanura [H]Z v t, see -badanudza.
bandadza [LLL]M n 5, pl: map-, see bandakadzi.
banzurwa [LHL]Z n 5, pl: mab-, Splinter of wood.
-bebura [L]KMZ v t Carry child on back. cp -bereka KKoMZ.
beta [LL]KM n 1a Member of beta clan (python).
bhamu [HL M; LH KZ]KMZ ideo of Hitting hard with fist or thrown object.
-bhebha [L] v i Do anything extremely well. <Nguni.
bhemhe [HH] n 1a, pl: vabh-, Donkey. <Nguni. cp mbongoro.
bheseni [HLL] n 5, pl: mabh-, Washbasin (portable). <Eng. cp dhishi; shambiro Z.
bidiri bidiri [LLL LLL]M ideo of Galloping cp gagadi gagadi KMZ.
bino [LL]KM n 5, pl: map-, Big nose. cp buno Z.
-bobodza [H] K v t Slap mouth. cp -bomodza KMZ. 2. Z Close eyes disdainfully.
bonzeka [LLL]Z n 5, pl: map-, see bonza.
bunge [LL]Z ideo, see bunga.

buri [HL]KMZ n 5, pl: mab-, Hole. Perforation. Aperture. Ndapona napaburi retsono: I had a very narrow escape (lit: I escaped by the eye of a needle). Kana munhu akafa aino mumvuri, vakuru vanoti, boorai buri pachengo, mumvuri ubude: when a person dies and his shadow still remains the elders say, "Make a hole through the wall so that the shadow can escape."
buzinyika [HHHH]M n 5, pl: mab-, Light-coloured person. cp dzvukudende KZ.

†-bvonga [H]KZ v t Stir up liquid in which sediment has settled (hence: disturb many people). 2. KM, see -bvongodza. Munhu ano musakanzwa anobvonga vari pasangano: an unruly member at a meeting disturbs the rest.
-bvukuta [H]Z v i, see -bvukucha.
-bvumbata [H]Z v t Grasp. cp -kwinyata KZ; -pfumbata MZ.
-bvumbukira [H]Z v t Beat an innocent person. 2. M Act hurriedly, impetuously.
-bvurubvujuka [H]KMZ v i Start up suddenly (animal).
-bvururuka [L]KMZ v i Be in disorder, scattered, higgledy-piggledy. Zviro zvake zvose zvakabvururuka mumba make: his things are scattered about in his house.
bvutu [LH]KZ ideo of Snatching. 2. M, see bvuti. <-bvuta. Mbavha yakati chikwama bvutu ndokutiza: the thief snatched the purse and made off.
bwadzira [LHL]K n 14 Feeling of teeth being on edge. cp ugugu KZ; uziza M.
-bwaidzira [H]Z v t & i, see -bwaidzika.
chaguduma [LHHL]Z n 7 Upright Starbur weed; Acanthospermum hispidum. cp chidhongi.

-chakadza [L]K v t Spatter. cp -chapatidza MZ. 2. Z Cut all over. Ndakamuchakadza nedemo: I have cut him all over with an axe. Musachakadzira mbwanana dzangu mvura: do not splash my puppies with water.
changa [LL]Z n 1a Despised person. cp mushorikani KMZ.
-chapfanya [H]MZ v t Eat with enjoyment. cp -chakanya K.
cheki [HL] n 9 Check pattern. <Eng. 2. Bank cheque.
chengo [LH]KKo n 7 Wall of building (unplastered or plastered). cp chidziro KM. 2. Z Wall of building before roof is put on.
rusero [LLL]KMZ n 11, pl: sero 10 K & tsero 10 MZ, Winnowing-basket. <-sera. cp bepe Ko.
rwanza [LL]KZ n 11, pl: nzwanza 10, Handful (rwanza rwoupfu, rwemari, etc). cp tsiva M.
-rwerwa [L]Z v t & i Drivel (saliva). 2. Water (mouth, because appetite awakened). Bere rinorwerwa mate kana raona nyama: a hyena's mouth waters when it has seen meat.
rwodzi [LH]KKoZ n 11, pl: nzwodzi, nzodzi & nzonzi- 10, Bast (strip of inner bark, esp when softened by chewing, pounding, etc).
-chezera [H; LHLH] v t Chisel. <Eng.
saimba [HLH]K n 1a Householder. cp saumba M.
sakambira [HHHL]M n 5 Natural gap between top front teeth. cp saka K; sakavadzimu Z.

-chicha [L]K v i Suffer. cp -niya KKoMZ. 2. Z Dance vigorously (esp one wearing leg rattles). 3. Z Rain heavily. 4. Z Trot (animal). cp -ndyandyata KZ; -nzunzuta MZ. 5. Z Walk long distance without stopping. Maziso anondichichisa: my eyes are hurting me. Ndakachicha kufamba ndichikutsvaga: I have walked myself off my feet looking for you.
chidhokwani [LLHH]Z n 7, see chidhoma.
chikangare [LHLL]Z n 7 Brown var sorghum.
Chikumi [LHH]KMZ n 1a June.
chimukanerimwe [LLLHHH]Z n 1a, see chikumukanarimwe.
chinana [LHH]Z n 7 Blemish, defect, flaw. cp chinanga MZ; chinongo K.
chingamidzo [HHHL]M n 9 Greeting. Salutation. cp kwaziso KMZ.
chinjiziri [LLLL]MZ ideo of Forming a rise (e g long narrow hill; welt where blow has been struck).
chioko muhomwe [LHH LHH]KMZ n 7 Contribution of money (e g by son to father to complete pfuma for his, the son's, roora). 2. K Monetary wealth.
chisekeranzira [LLLLLL]MZ n 7 Girl lacking in reserve. <-seka nzira.
chitumbaduri [LHHHH]Z n 7 Funeral dance (on return from burial). 2. MZ Hunter’s dance.
-chiva [H]KMZ v t & i Covet. Lust after. > ruchiva; ruchivo.
dzvuturire [LHHL]KMZ ideo of Bulging eyes. cp dzvutu K.
gwenyakwenya [LHLL]KZ n 5, pl: makw-, sp Twining perennial with stinging hairs: Tragua okanuya pax. cp rwenya KZ; rwenyakwenya K.
-pingudzana [L]M v t, reciprocal plural subject. Disapprove of; Disagree with.
-tango- [H]KMZ defective v Be or do first (in a sequence). <-tanga.
-unanidza [L]KZ v i, see -unaidza. <-una.
-va [H]M v i (Also, when used statively, specifically) Appear in good condition. Akwegura zvake asi achakava: he is old but still looks healthy.
chizende [LLL]K n 7 Sensuality. Self-indulgence. cp dashira Z.
-chogodoka [LHLHL]Z v i, see -chodogoka.
-choora [H]KMZ v t, see -choona.

-dai [LH]KKoMZ defective v Do or say like this. > -daianirano; -daiano; -dairo; -daiso. Anodai: he does like this. Daizvi: do like this. Kudaizvi hembe yangu: why have you spoilt my shirt? Handidi kunzwa zvakadai: I do not want to hear such things.
-daianisano [H]Z defective v Make to say or do this to one another. Nzara ndiyo yakadaianisano vanhu: it is hunger that has made the people do this to one another.
-dairo [H]Z defective v Say for someone, or do for someone, in this way. Unodairo, kutenda kwazvo, namaoko maviri: this is how you thank heartily, with two hands.
dandaburwa [LLHL]Z n 5, pl: mad-, Large plot of ground.
dandadziva [LLLL]KZ n 5, pl: mat-, Long pool. Usatambe kumatandadziva, unorumwa namakarwe: do not play in the long, deep stretches of the river, you will be eaten by crocodiles.
-dare [H]M defective v Do like that. cp -daro KMZ.
-dari [LHL]Ko(B) defective v Do in that way. cp -daro KMZ. Kudariku uri kuti uri kuitei pano: what do you really think you are doing here?
-dariro [H]KZ defective v: Say, or do, like that, for someone or some purpose. Unodarirei: why do you say, or do that?
-dariso [H]MZ defective v: Cause to say or do in that way. cp -deriso K. Chiiko chinokudariso: what makes you say, or do that?

-davira [H]KMZ v t & i Answer; respond; reply. cp -pindura KKoMZ. 2. Admit; acknowledge. 3. Believe. > chidaviro; rudaviro. Kana munhu akadaidzwa anoti we kudavira: if a person has been called to, he says "we" in reply. Nyaya inodavirika: a trustworthy account. Unodavira makuhwa: you believe calumny.
deko renzviru [HH HLL]MZ n 5 Dark brown (lit: shell of fruit of Wild Medlar). Ano utema hwedeko renzviru: he is dark brown in colour.
-dembetera [H]KM v t & i Ask repeatedly. cp -detembura Z.

denga denga [HL HL Z; LH LH K]KZ ideo of Balancing object on head. 2. of Making off, or for. Akafuma achingoti denga denga nehari kutsime: she got up early, put the pot on her head and went to the well.
-deranirano [H]K defective v, see -daranirano.
-derano [H]K defective v, see -darano.
-deriso [H]K defective v, see -dariso.
-deya [H]K defective v Do in that way which is known to you. Musikana wandakadeya kuruma akawanikwa nomumwe: that girl to whom, as you know, I proposed marriage is now married to someone else.
-dhabhuka [H]M v i Be, or be able to be, snapped in two (e g string). cp -dambuka KMZ.
dhende [LH]KZ n 5, pl: madh-, Forest Elephant Shrew R 35. cp dune MZ.
dhidhi dhidhi [LL LL]KMZ ideo of Walking vigorously. Akanzwa kunze kwedumba kwotonzi dhidhi dhidhi: he heard rapid footsteps outside the shelter.
dhiraivha [LHLL] n 1a, pl: vanadh-, madh-, Driver. < Eng. cp mutekenyi KMZ.

-di [LHL]KKoZ defective v Do in which way. cp -dinyi M. Wakadii: how are you? Zvadii: what is the matter? Kundodii: what for? Unozvidii: what do you do with them? Ndadiiko: what have I done? Ko, ndagodii: what can I have done? Wati kudii: what did you say?
-dingaidza [H]Z v t Cause to be conceited. Usadingaidze mwana nokumupa zvose zvaanoda: do not spoil the child by giving him everything he wants.
-dinyi [H]M defective v Do in which way. cp -dii KKoZ. Makadini: how are you?
-dongonyodza [H]KZ v t Desire (food or drink). 2. Entice (by offer of food). Make to desire food.
-donzva [H]KKoZ v i Walk with aid of a stick. > mudonzvo. cp -dondodza MZ. Baba vakadii zvavo? Vachiri kudonzva: how is father? He is well.
-dosha [L]K v t & i Be overtalkative. cp -dorongosha Z. 2. Pester (esp by asking questions). cp -nhosha Z.
-dudzira [L]KZ v t Explain. <-dudza. cp -tsanangura KKoMZ. 2. Interpret. cp -turikira KMZ. Ndidudzire mafambisiro emotokari: explain to me how a motor-car works.
dukutu [LHL]M n 1a Child that has just learnt to speak. cp kapapandipetadha Z.
dundundu [HHH]Z ideo of Being angry, sulky.
dwingiri [HHHH]Z ideo of Piercing through. cp boo KMZ. Akanzi nomuseve dwingiri: he was pierced by an arrow.
dzvoti [LH]KZ n 5, pl: matsv-, House snake. cp tsvoti KM.
-ereka [L]Z v t & i Aim at. 2. Hit (after aiming). cp -irika K; -tonda MZ. Rega kurova pose pose, ereka musoro wayo: do not hit it all over the place, aim at its head.
fa-a [L]KMZ ideo of Spraying (continuously). 2. Z of Being relaxed, happy. 3. K of Being extended. Akagara akati fa-a: he sat completely relaxed.
fekeshe fekeshe [LLL LLL]KZ ideo of Walking in sand. cp zhaka zhaka KM. 2. M of Rustling (moving through dry undergrowth). cp pfokocho KMZ.
-fenga [H]K v t & i Become hollow-stomached through hunger. Draw in stomach. cp -fenengadza Z.
festiyedhi [HLHL] n 9 First-aid. <Eng.
fetya fetya [HL HL]Z ideo of Walking importantly with shoulders hunched.
-fonyoka [H]KMZ v i Bend (gen of metal). Handidi mupinyi wakafonyoka: I do not want a bent handle.

-fufura [L]KZ v t & i Waddle. 2. K Bribe person to speak on one's behalf or judge in one's favour. Prime a person. Haachambofufura nokuti aisofadzwa nezvakatongwa: he will pay no more bribes, he is quite satisfied with the decision.

-fufuridza [L]K v t & i Seek (to eat). 2. KZ Walk by night in a place that awakens fear. Mbwa isina tenzi anofunga inofufuridza mafufu anodonhera patafura dzamara igute: a dog without an owner who cares for it seeks for the crumbs falling from the table until it is full.
fuku fuku [LH LH]KZ ideo of Scooping with hands (soil from hole).

-fukusa [L]KZ v t & i Burrow slowly in soft ground. 2. Pain. Afflict. 3. Z Poke fire. cp -jogonya KMZ. Uya nomujokoro ufukuse maburi echirei: bring the big auger and clean the dirt out of the holes in the sledge. Ronda raya kufukusa urwa: the wound has become painfully inflamed.
fumba [HL]K ideo of Closing hand on something. cp pfumba MZ.
-funda [H; LHL] v t & i Learn. <Nguni. cp -dzidza KMZ.

-fundikidza [H]Z v t Set aside temporarily in very secret place. 2. Tie money inside knots in clothing. 3. Prevail upon a person by words. cp -gombedzera KZ; -pfimba M. Rega kuramba wakafundikidza hwahwa waitirwa basa: do not keep on hiding the beer when people have finished their work for you. Akafundikidza mari mudhuku, yamachena payo, yamapepa payo: she tied her money in knots in her headkerchief, the silver in one, paper-money in another.
-fura [L]KKoMZ v t & i Graze. 2. M Shear (sheep).
gabada gabada [LLL LLL]MZ ideo of Walking noisily (e g with oversized shoes).
gambamukoyokoyo [LLLHLH]Ko n 5, pl: mak-, Crab. cp gakanje KMZ.
-ganhira [H M; LHLH Z]MZ v i Be bold (child). Speak out of turn. Violate etiquette.
gara [LL]K n 5, pl: mak-, Convulsions (of child). cp berevere KM; buka KZ; dzuni Ko. 2. Big, deadly thing (esp snake). cp garanyanya KZ. 3. Savage person. cp gandanga KMZ.
gate [HL]KZ n 5, pl: mak-, Large earthenware pot in which beer is set to ferment. cp mbiziro M. 2. M Pot in which beer is boiled. cp rukambe KZ.
gidhi [LH]Z n 5, pl: mag-, Unevenness of surface (road or field). cp gadhi MZ.
godi godi [HL HL]KZ ideo of Climbing up (e g ladder). cp kata kata KMZ. Akati godi godi kunhengenywa kwomuti: he climbed to the very top of the tree.
godzonga [HH]Z n 1a & 5 Tyrant.
gotwe [LH]MZ n 1a & 5, pl: vag- & mag-, Last-born child (opposite to dangwe). cp rugotwe KZ.
gude [LL]KZ ideo of Covering completely (e g with blanket). Gomo rose rakazvi gude nemiti: the whole hill is covered with trees.
gufu [LH]MZ n 1a (M), 5 (Z), pl: vana- (M), mag- (Z), Toad. 2. Albino. cp sope KM.
gundumure [LLLL]K n 1a Big-headed person. cp chimusoro MZ.
gunduru [HHH]KMZ ideo of Finishing off (food or liquid). 2. KZ of Rolling (esp heavy hollow object). 3. MZ of Making resounding sound (empty metal drum hit by stone or other drum).
Gunyana [HHH]KMZ n 1a & 5 September.
gurumazeve [LLHLH]Z n 1a Person with big ears (deprecatory).
gusu [HL]MZ ideo of Nodding with sleep. cp dimwa KZ.
gutswa gutswa [HL HL]MZ ideo, see gutsa gutsa.
-guvura [H]K v t & i, see -guura.
gwa gwa gwa [L L L]MZ ideo of Making heavy footsteps.
-gwacharika [L]KMZ v i Fall and make rattling sound (e g loose bundle of firewood). 2. Lie in disorder. 3. Z, see -gwabaira. Mapadza akagwacharika panze: the hoes are lying about in the yard.
gwada gwada [HL HL]KZ ideo of Walking on knees.
gwarikwari [LHLL]M n 5, pl: magw-, Square-nosed monitor lizard. cp gwashadombo KZ.
-gwashura [H M; L Z]MZ v t Snip. cp -chetura KMZ. 2, see -gwishura KMZ.
gwedere gwedere [LLL LLL]KMZ ideo of Walking feebly (person or animal).
gwenjere [LHL]Z n 5, pl: magw-, Section of dried mealie stalk between two joints. 2. Rib of dried tobacco leaf.

gwindiri [HHH]KMZ ideo of Being strong and healthy. 2. KM of Being left unguarded. cp gwendere MZ. Vakati zvavo gwindiri: they are well. Ini gwindiri zvangu: I am quite well, thank you. Banga ndarirongera wakati munzira gwindiri: I found the knife lying in the path.
-hachika [H]Z v i Be, or be able to be, caught by something projecting (e g tree-stump).
hadiyo [HLL] n 9 Garlic. <For.

hamheno [LHH]KMZ defective v I do not know (often with implication that I do not care either). cp hapeno KoM. Abrv: "mheno". Hamheno zvimwe anouya nhasi: perhaps he will come today. Hamheno zvake: that is his affair.
hapeno [LHH]KKoZ defective v, see hamheno.
-hi [H]M defective v It is said. cp -nzi KMZ.
hiri [H]K ideo of Lifting heavy load onto a person. cp hi KMZ.
hiri [HL]Z ideo of Becoming mad. Akabva ati hiri kupenga: so he went off his head.
huma huma [HL HL]M ideo of Walking with head nodding (esp people). cp nguma nguma K; ngumwa ngumwa Z.
hwa [L]Z ideo of Bending in order to conceal oneself.
-hwengezudza [H]Z v t Make to snatch or seize hold of. cp -hweshudza KZ.
hwenye [LL]MZ n 14 News. cp shoko KKoMZ. 2. Gossip. 3. Rumour. cp runyere-rupe KZ. 4. M Loquacity. cp urevi KZ. Ndipe hwenye hweko wabva: tell me the news of where you are coming from.
hwereshenga [LLLL]Z n 9 Big, old crocodile.
hwidibo [HHL]KMZ n 9 Lid.
hwiza rukuni [HL LHH]Z n 9 Stick insect. cp mhashu rukuni K.
hwusha [HH]KZ n 10 Girdles (supporting mbereko); sg: rukusha.
i [L]K defective v: Be said. cp -nzi KZ; -zi M. Kui uya nababa: father says you are to come.
inawina [LLLH]M n 1a Wife in addition to the first. cp mukaranga KZ.
-indirra [L]K v i Make progress (esp cultural, when used with mbere). cp -enderera MZ.
-jatangura [H]Z v i, see -jatanguka.
-jenen'eka [H]M v i Shine brightly (esp sun). cp -toya KoMZ.
-jita [H]MZ v t & i, see -jeza.
jombo [HL] n 5 & 9, pl: maj-, Boot. <For. cp nyombo. 2. sp Hoe with ring into which handle fits. cp bhidha M.
-jumbha [L]Z v t & i Poke (person). cp -tibvura KZ; -tumbunya M. 2. Hit mouth of opponent with head or fist. 3. K Strike without warning. cp -futa KZ.
kaboko [LHL]M n 1a Confirmed bachelor. cp tsvukachin'ai K.
-kabudza [H]Z v t Make full (container).

-kamba [H]KZ v & i Catch scent. Follow a clue. 2. Thrust oneself into a conversation. Interrupt. cp -dzengedza M. Imbwa dzakakamba hwema ndokuenda: the dogs caught the scent and went. Akakambira nyaya: he broke into the conversation.
kamona [HL]Z ideo of Rising (dust, etc). cp bwititi KZ; tibu MZ.
kanganya kanganya [HHL HHL]KMZ ideo of Walking, or acting, proudly. 2. KZ of Walking deliberately with sideways or backward glances (as lion, or baboon does). 3. M, see kanganda kanganda.
-kapidza [L]Z v t Set on fire by spreading (as grass fire does). 2. Flick with whip. cp -kwipura KZ.

-karakadza [H]Z v t & i Speak loudly in self-defence. 2. MZ Make a statement of whose truth one is not certain. 3. M Imagine. Ndinokarakadza kuti ndiwe ndakapa bhuku rangu (M): I think it is you to whom I gave my book. Karakadza sokunge uri kugara pamwedzi (M): imagine you are living on the moon.
karudu [LHL]Z n 13 Touchiness, liability to take offence at trifles. cp chirudu KZ.
kekeya kekeya [LLH LLH]Z ideo of Walking like a crab. 2. of Limping.
-keruka [H Z; L M]MZ v i Be able to be torn lengthwise.
kindingi kindingi [LLH LLH]KMZ ideo of Beating drum (medium-sized).
-kopeka [L]MZ v i Droop. Wilt. cp -ziya KZ. 2. Z Hang over an edge (as hair over forehead).
-korokodza [H]KZ v t & i Sift evidence. Examine critically. Search for matter to incriminate someone. cp -tsonyopodza MZ. 2. Cross-examine.
-kotsomora [H]M v i, see -kotsora.
kovo [LL]M n 1a, pl: vak-, Slender Mongoose R 142. cp govo K; kahovo Z.
kozi [HL]Z ideo of Sitting in raised position alone. 2. of Sitting in position of honour. 3. of Sitting on top.
kuba [HL]Z ideo of Covering with lid. cp kwidiba KMZ.
-kunyungudza [H]Z v t & i Shake buttocks when dancing (coarse expr).
-kurukudza [H]Z v t & i Converse in a lively manner. 2. Narrate in detail. cp -dodomesa KZ.
-kutidza [L]KZ v t Push burning stick further into fire. cp -kuchidzira KMZ. Kutidzira moto urege kudzima: stoke the fire lest it go out.
kuwerere [HLLL]Z ideo of Applauding loudly. > makuwerere.
kwadzanai [LHHH]Z n 1a sp Flying insect (infests vegetable plants; found in pairs).
-kwakwachuka [H]Z v i, see -kwakwabvuka. 2. M Be forced apart (pieces of metal). cp -kwachanuka MZ.
-kwipuka [L]Z v i Be, or be able to be, uprooted.
mafifinya [LHHL]K n 1a Person with ugly face.
mafundo mafundo [LHH LHH]Z n 6 Turmoil. Boiling of water in rapids.
mafunzu [LHH]M n 6 Ear-wax. cp mafunzi KZ.

mai [HH]KM n 1a, pl: vadzimai, madzimai, mamai K, vamai, vanamai, Mother. cp amai KoZ. 2. MZ Mrs. Mai Kubvaruno: Mrs Kubvaruno. Note that it is polite to address a married woman, not by her own name, but as mai vaPunha, where Punha stands for the name of one of her children.
makei [LHL]KMZ n 1a Last year. Next year. Makei akapera: last year. Makei anouya: next year. Makei udya (K): year before last.
mananzvabanga [LHLHH]K n 1a & 6 Greedy person. cp mudyanerembwa Z; mupoki KM.
mangu [HL]Z ideo of Filling container of any kind with anything. cp pamupamu KMZ. 2. M of Taking big bite of soft object (e g sweet potato).
-mba [H]K defective v: Exceedingly. Superlatively. cp -isvo- KKoZ. Ndakamba ndamurova: I gave him a thorough thrashing. Ukaona rovambira umba wamhanya: if you see a mamba run as fast as you can.
†mbezo [LL]KMZ n 9 Adze. < -veza.
mbiriyakare [HHHLL]Z n 1a & 9, see mbiri yakare.
mbizhimbizhizhi [HHHHH]Z n 9 Act of carrying loads that project upwards. Kwakaitwa mbizhimbizhizhi yokutakura rukweza mumatengu: the people carried the millet in baskets on their heads.
menyengu [HHL]Z ideo of Peeling (e g orange). cp fefengu KMZ.
mepfu [HL]KZ ideo of Breaking piece off soft object (e g cold sadza). cp medu KMZ. 2. MZ of Biting soft object (e g cake). cp mopfo KMZ.
mhambo [LL]K n 9 Hen. cp nhunzvi yehuku KZ; tseketse M.
-mhaudza [H]Z vt, see -mhaura.
†moyo [LL]KKo n 3, pl: moyo, Heart (physical organ). cp mwoyo MZ. 2. KZ Heart (mutupo).
mugumisiro [LHHHL]KMZ n 3 Way of ending. 2. Result. Outcome. <-gumisa.
mukeche [LLH]Z n 3, see mukeshe.
mukugu [LLL]M n 1, pl: vamuk-, Lion R 191. cp shumba KKoMZ.
munya munya [HL HL]K ideo of Walking naked. cp kwinya kwinya MZ.
muputi [LLL]Z n 3 Medicated string worn by girls round loins.
musvau [LLH]Z n 1 Poor person (having barest necessities of life). cp nyapena M. 2. M, pl: vamu-, vanamu-, Leopard R 185. cp mbada KKoMZ.
mutiro [LLL]M n 1, pl: mat-, vamut-, vanamut-, Baboon R 9. cp gudo KKoMZ.
muumbira [LHLH]M n 1, pl: vamuu-, vanamuu-, Mason wasp. cp mbuzvambuzva KZ.
mvaka mvaka [HL HL]Z ideo of Acting or walking vigorously (gen ostentatiously).
-mveyesana [H]KZ v t & i Pursue a fast, dodging person or animal. <-mveya. 2. Waltz.
mwari [LH]K n 3 Roof-pole. cp bina KZ; mhina M. Mwari muduku: lesser roof-pole.
-mwaudza [H]K v t & i Make annoying noise. 2. Annoy by making annoying noise. cp -nyaudza KMZ.
nan'ana [LLH]Z ideo of Staring amusedly. 2. of Looking at.
-nanura [L]KZ v t & i Intervene (between two opposed people, etc). cp -nunura KMZ.

-nga- [L]KMZ defective v Be. (-nga+participial complement is formative of past tenses). Ndakanga ndichifamba: I was walking. Ndainga ndine basa: I used to have work to do (M).

-nge [L]KKoZ defective v Seem. Be like. Be likely. Probable. Be (perfect sense). > -mbe-nge; -genge; -nenge; -tenge; -zenge; -chinge; -kange, etc. cp -nga KoM. Anenge mukomana akatendika: he seems to be a trustworthy boy. Tenge ticharumwa: we are likely to be bitten. Vanenge vachifunga kuti mumwedzi munogara tsuro: they seem to think that there is a hare living in the moon. Rodza mapfumo ange zvisvo: make the spears as sharp as razors. Inge munhu: behave (like a person)! Note use of kunge as conj meaning, If. When. As though. Unopiwa mubayiro kunge wapedza basa: you will get your money when you have finished the work. Zvakaita sokunge zvichapera: it was as though they were finishing. Kuzenge auya, mutaurire kuti tsamba yake yasvika: if it should happen that he arrives, tell him that his letter has come.
-nge [L]M defective v: Be. (-nge participial complement is formative of past tenses). Ndakange ndichifamba: I was walking. cp -nga KMZ. Ndainge ndiine basa (KKoZ): I used to have work.
-ngengedza [H]MZ v t Ring (bell; not electric bell). cp -ngongodza KZ.

-ngo- [L]KKoZ defective v Only. (nga + contracted infinitive complement, indicates that action of complement is the only action taking place). > -tongo-; -chango-; -gongo-; -singo-. Ndakangomukwazisa ndokubva andirova: I did no more than greet him, whereupon he beat me. Ingoenda: please go at once! Handidongoseki nhasi: I do not want to laugh at all today.

†-ri [L]KKoMZ defective v Be. As a defective verb it has only Indicative, Par & Rel Pres, simple & progressive, in affirm & neg. Except with adverbial complement it is not used in 3rd pers in Indic affirm & in affirm Rel of direct relation. The compound predicate -ri+infinitive complement supplies the continuous aspect of the verb's conjugation. Zviri nani...: it is preferable... Isu tiri vaRozvi, tinoera moyo: we are Rozvi who venerate the heart. Avo vaRozvi, vanoera moyo: they are Rozvi who venerate the heart. Ari muchikoro: he is in school. Haachisiri mwana: she is no longer a child. Chiripo chiripo: things are what they are and we must put up with them. Ndiri kudya: I am eating.

†-ti [L]KKoMZ defective v Say. Think. Do. 2. MZ Address a person with a term expressing relationship. cp -idza K. Ndati: "Uya neni": I said: "Come with me". Ndati zvimwe chipoko: I thought that perhaps it was a ghost. Taiti murume kutsvaga namo, mudzimai kuonga ndarama: what we used to do was this: the man went in search of beeswax, his wife panned gold. Unomutii: what relationship has he to you? Note the following idiomatic usages: 1. Kuti introduces ideophones; iti nho: be quiet! 2. Introduces actions; Mukomana uya ndokutsvaga nokutsvaga basa akati arishaya: that boy looked and looked for work and did not find it. 3. Introduces indirect speech as a narrative form indicating action; Zuva rikati ndopisa: the sun grew hot. 4. Introduces a sentence or a series of clauses with a definite subject, or with an indeterminate subject; Motokari iyi inoti ukafamba nayo nokusvika mumatope haunyuri: what this motor-car does is this, if you travel in it and reach a boggy spot you will not sink. Kwakati mwedzi mitatu yapfuura, vakamutandanisa pachikoro: what happened was this, after three months there, he was expelled from the school. 5. Itself taking an infinitive as object, kuti introduces a series of consecutive forms; Vamwe vanoti kungodzvuta vodhakwa: some people just take a sip and at once get drunk. 6. Kuti expresses "both . . . and" of actions; Tsika iyi yakati kunaka ikati kuipa: this custom is both good and bad. 7. With participials of all tenses kuti forms compound predicates with introductory function; Ati achisvika, mvura ndokutanga kunaya: when he was arriving, it began to rain. 8. In a compound predicate, with complement in pres perf aspect, or pres excl, kuti translates, "yet, ever"; Wati waona nyoka here: have you ever seen a snake? Handisati ndaona nyoka: I have never seen a snake. Mvura yati yona here: is it raining yet? 9. Followed by pres subjunct, in the 1st pers, kuti expresses action attempted but thwarted; Ndinoti ndinurinze, obva ochema: if I try to put him to sleep he cries. Makudo akati tidye mabarwe 'ndokufurwa: the baboons tried to eat the maize but they were shot. 10. Kuti forms the indefinite nouns and qualifiers of quantity, place, etc: nyakuti, yokuti, etc. Akati ndinoda n'ombe dzakati, ndigokupa mari yakati: he said he wanted such and such cattle and he would give me so much money. 11. Forms conj nokuti; nezvokuti; sokuti; kunoti; kukati; kuzoti; zvinoti. 12. Emphasises events or facts through idiomatic use of oti, kwoti: Oti ndiwe wakandituka nezuro: look here, it was you who scolded me yesterday. Kwoti vana ndovako: the point is, the children are yours. 13. Replaces -va (M): Kati katatu: that makes it three times. cp Kava katatu (KZ).

-tibuka [H]KMZ v i Rise (esp dust or thick smoke). 2. KZ Gather (people). 3. KZ Move out in a crowd. 4. Z Scatter (grain pounded in over-full dûri). 5. M Leave, many (not in a crowd) to go somewhere. Huruva inotibuka kana vanhu vachipura: dust rises when people are threshing. Vanhu vanotibukira kubhawa: people go in a big crowd to the beer hall.
-tsatsarika [L]KZ v i Stagger. cp -dzedzereka KKoMZ. 2. M Make convulsive movements when dying. cp -pfurupfutika KMZ.

-tsetsa [L]KMZ v t & i Make to laugh. Be funny. 2. KZ Grind finely. cp -otsa KMZ. 3. Z Make smooth (e g plane). 4. M Carve. cp -veza KKoMZ. Sakura uchitsetsa (KZ): weed, leaving no weeds behind.

-tsika [L]KKoMZ v t & i Set foot on. Crush underfoot. > chitsikiso; chitsiko; tsiko. 2. K Close or twitch one eye. cp -tsinya MZ. Akatsikwa nemotokari: he was run over by a car. Vano ukama hwakatsikana: they are related in a complicated way. Akanditsikisa nebhasikoro: he had me knocked down by a bicycle. Bhuku iri rakatsikiswa Harare: this book was printed in Salisbury. Ari kutsika-tsika: he is hesitating (to make a decision). Kutsika namana: to walk on all fours (K)/ to be stable (Z).

-tsvereretsa [L]Z vt, see -tsveremutsa.

tuni [HL]KZ ideo of Looking upwards; of Lifting nose (e g dog to catch scent). Ndebvu dzakangoiti mudenga tuni: his head went back and his beard pointed upwards.

-vhundunyudza [L]Z vt, see -vhundunyutsa Z.
